rules.title: Name of the Commodity
rules.description: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity.

rules.title: Name of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
rules.description: The package must declare the name of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer.

rules.title: Complete Address
rules.description: The complete registered address of the manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared.

rules.title: Net Quantity in Standard Units
rules.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard units (g/kg for mass, ml/L for volume) using the metric system. Vague terms like 'Large Pack' are not permitted.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes)
rules.description: MRP must be declared with the Rupee symbol/₹ and the words 'inclusive of all taxes'.

rules.title: Month & Year of Manufacture/Packing/Import
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, packed, or imported must be declared (format: MM/YYYY or Month YYYY).

rules.title: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: A telephone number, email or address for consumer complaints must be declared.

rules.title: Minimum Font Size for Declarations
rules.description: Declarations must meet minimum height: 1mm up to 200g/ml, 2mm from 200g/ml to 1kg/L, 4mm above 1kg/L.
